description: Enrich company and person records with CUFinder.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: CUFinder API key sent in the x-api-key header. Find it under Account > API key at https://dashboard.cufinder.io.

actions.name: enrich_company
actions.description: Enrich a company name, domain, or LinkedIn company URL with firmographic and contact data.

query.description: A company name, domain, or LinkedIn company URL.

company.description: The company profile returned by CUFinder, including firmographic and contact fields when available.

confidence.description: The confidence score assigned to the result.

query.description: The normalized query processed by CUFinder.

charged.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

remaining.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

credits.description: Credit usage reported by CUFinder for the request.

meta.description: Match and billing metadata returned by CUFinder.

outputSchema.description: The enriched company profile and CUFinder request metadata.

actions.name: enrich_person
actions.description: Enrich a person's full name and company with professional and contact data.

company.description: The person's company name, domain, or LinkedIn company URL.

inputSchema.description: The person and company identifiers used for enrichment.

person.description: The person profile returned by CUFinder, including job, company, contact, and professional fields when available.

confidence.description: The confidence score assigned to the result.

query.description: The normalized query processed by CUFinder.

charged.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

remaining.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

credits.description: Credit usage reported by CUFinder for the request.

meta.description: Match and billing metadata returned by CUFinder.

outputSchema.description: The enriched person profile and CUFinder request metadata.

person.description: The person profile returned by CUFinder, including job, company, contact, and professional fields when available.

confidence.description: The confidence score assigned to the result.

actions.name: find_company_domain
actions.description: Find a company's official website domain from its name, with optional country and address hints.

name.description: The company name to resolve, such as Stripe.

countryCode.description: An optional two-letter ISO country code used to disambiguate the company. CUFinder defaults to US.

address.description: An optional company address used as an additional disambiguation hint.

inputSchema.description: The company details used to find its official domain.

confidence.description: The confidence score assigned to the result.

query.description: The normalized query processed by CUFinder.

charged.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

remaining.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

credits.description: Credit usage reported by CUFinder for the request.

meta.description: Match and billing metadata returned by CUFinder.

outputSchema.description: The resolved company domain and CUFinder request metadata.

actions.name: find_company_name
actions.description: Find a company's registered name from its website domain.

domain.description: The company domain to resolve, such as stripe.com.

inputSchema.description: The domain used to identify the company.

name.description: The company name associated with the domain.

confidence.description: The confidence score assigned to the result.

query.description: The normalized query processed by CUFinder.

charged.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

remaining.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

credits.description: Credit usage reported by CUFinder for the request.

meta.description: Match and billing metadata returned by CUFinder.

outputSchema.description: The resolved company name and CUFinder request metadata.
